speaker: Marcus Webb
cascadeSummary: Executed Month-eight disbursement review, approving stabilization assistance for 12 additional households and deploying Downtown canvass operations to assess commercial corridor needs. Compliance documentation remains audit-ready for all cases.

statements.decision: Approved Month-eight disbursement batch and deployed Downtown canvass teams
statements.quote: Twelve more households stabilized means twelve more families who won’t face displacement this month—and every case file meets compliance standards that will survive audit.
statements.fullStatement: The West Oakland Stabilization Fund has completed its Month-eight disbursement review, approving stabilization assistance for twelve additional households. This brings the total number of households stabilized to eighty-one. Each case has undergone rigorous eligibility review to ensure funds are disbursed cleanly and in full compliance with program guidelines. Concurrently, we have deployed canvass teams to Downtown commercial corridors to assess stabilization needs in areas showing signs of decline. Every application moves with the certainty of audit-ready documentation.
